record_title: Connected linear groups collapse exponential spectra on classical Banach spaces
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The collapse criterion is elementary and its forward implication was explicitly known by 2009; the originality claim concerns its application to the 2026 classical-space question. "Classical sequence or function space" is broader than the stated canonical families, so the open question is not claimed solved in full. The complete Daniel--Ghosh and Pliev--Sukochev--Tomskova journal texts were not inspected.
